scope: Poaceae existing canonical name/concept verification only

nomenclatural_sources.finding: Cenchrus spinifex Cav. accepted at species rank; 13 heterotypic synonyms include C. albertsonii Runyon, C. incertus M.A.Curtis, C. roseus E.Fourn. ex Hemsl. and C. strictus Chapm.

nomenclatural_sources.authority: Wipff (2026), Journal of the Botanical Research Institute of Texas 20(1):1-44
nomenclatural_sources.finding: Type- and voucher-based Texas revision reinstates C. albertsonii, C. incertus, C. roseus, C. strictus, C. bambusoides and describes C. densiflorus Wipff; narrower species circumscriptions than currently shown by POWO for several names.

taxa.conflict: Current POWO/WCVP broad synonymy is in explicit taxon-concept tension with Wipff's 2026 type-based Texas revision. Preserve both as attributed, do not claim one universally resolved, and do not convert original observations/photographs labeled C. spinifex to reinstated segregates without mature-bur/voucher evidence.
taxa.photo_identity_hold: Existing canonical photographs have source-level determinations but lack independently verified complete mature fascicles and contemporary key/voucher confirmation. Preserve existing provisional source identity and scientific holds.
taxa.hybrid_hold: No hybrid determination made; any existing hybrid holds are untouched.

review_outcome: One existing Poaceae species accepted by POWO; document conflict with 2026 Texas segregate revision as unresolved source-concept issue, not an automatic synonym remapping.
commit_policy: Evidence only; no canonical species, photos, lessons, installer, county nativity, Pages or Sheets edits.
